name: Spline
title: spline.design
shortDescription: Spline is a web-based 3D design tool that enables real-time collaboration among teams. Users can create, edit, and export 3D designs directly in the browser. It supports interactive elements, physics simulations, and various export formats. Ideal for designers looking to integrate 3D elements into web projects or create interactive experiences. An example use case is a design team collaborating on a 3D model for a virtual reality application.
cons: Potentially steep learning curve for beginners

aiSuggestedAlternatives.name: SketchUp
aiSuggestedAlternatives.reason: User-friendly 3D modeling tool with a free version

aiSuggestedAlternatives.reason: Simple, online 3D design and 3D printing app
